note: Resolutions that hand-written pages depend on. etl/resolve_watched.py looks each one up in the parsed meeting data after every meeting sync and records how the Board voted, in web/public/data/watched-resolutions.json; the pages read their status from there, so a vote changes them with no one editing a page. `match` is a case-insensitive phrase from the agenda title. `followUps` lists what a person (or the drafting agent) still has to do once the vote is in, because it needs judgment rather than a status flip.

items.match: Execute Stipulation with Riverhead Town Police Benevolent Association
followUps: If adopted: treat the PBA's 2027 rate as contractual (3.75% plus $500) in etl/predict_2027.py and lib/labor-contracts-2027.ts instead of the trailing-average placeholder.
If adopted: set PoliceContracts2027.adopted in the iOS and Android apps.

items.match: Execute Stipulation with Riverhead Town Superior Officers Association
followUps: If adopted: treat the SOA's 2027 rate as contractual (3.75% plus $500) in etl/predict_2027.py and lib/labor-contracts-2027.ts.
If adopted: set PoliceContracts2027.adopted in the iOS and Android apps.
